key.name: focus
key.description: Calms the contour terrain on the desktop. Ripples from events still show.

key.name: idle-fps
key.description: How often the terrain redraws while nothing is moving. 0 keeps it still until something happens. Ripples and changes always run at full speed.

key.name: privacy
key.summary: How much a notification shows on the island
key.description: all: title and text. title: the title and the app name. app: only the app name. Events you send to the island yourself are always shown in full.

key.name: palette
key.description: The colours of the terrain, the bar, the menus and the island. All palettes are light.

key.name: replace-banners
key.description: App notifications open the island instead of GNOME's banner. They stay in the message list. Turn off to get GNOME's banners back.
